task: Adopt the OpenForge Kubernetes Zero Trust security baseline, profile standard, for the k3s node scope of the hybrid topology (#74)

events.summary: Scoped to pod hardening and NetworkPolicy on the three MLOps workloads (mlflow/seaweedfs/prefect) plus one ADR and one D-registry row; L2 opt-in full-stack external-cluster netpol/exposure behavior explicitly excluded and recorded as unverified
mlflow/seaweedfs/prefect ran as root with no seccomp profile, no dropped capabilities, and no NetworkPolicy, so a compromised container had unrestricted lateral movement inside the cluster

Added non-root UID/GID/fsGroup 65532, seccompProfile RuntimeDefault, allowPrivilegeEscalation false, all capabilities dropped and readOnlyRootFilesystem to mlflow/seaweedfs/prefect and the curl init container; added scripts/k8s/network-policies.yaml with app-scoped default-deny policies; recorded topology inventory and per-control verdicts in ADR-0003 (EN + ko); added D38

Independent approval review returned REJECT: the prefect PVC ownership migration was an out-of-band manual node-side chown recorded only in the ADR, provision.rs hardcoded the full manifest list as a second source of truth against D23/D26, and the NetworkPolicy lateral-movement CIDRs were colima-specific with no note for D26 external targets. Fixed by adding a declarative volume-permissions initContainer (the one container allowed to run as root, keeping seccomp RuntimeDefault, no privilege escalation, read-only rootfs, and dropping every capability except CHOWN/FOWNER/DAC_OVERRIDE) that migrates ownership idempotently; collapsing the provision.rs test to assert only D13's Secret-first ordering instead of full list equality; and documenting the CIDR values as colima-specific at the rule site

On the live colima k3s cluster: kubectl kustomize scripts/k8s/ succeeded (421 lines); kubectl apply --dry-run=server -k scripts/k8s/ clean; NetworkPolicy enforcement confirmed empirically via k3s's embedded kube-router controller (264 KUBE-ROUTER iptables chains; default-deny produced connection refused, an allow rule restored HTTP 200). A negative control was run for the ownership migration specifically because a check that always passes is not evidence: the PV directory was deliberately regressed to root:root, prefect was restarted, the volume-permissions initContainer reached Completed, ownership came back as 65532:65532, the pod reached 1/1 with 0 restarts, and /api/health answered HTTP 200. make verify: 119 Rust tests passed, clippy -D warnings clean, tsc --noEmit clean, design lint clean, web build clean
events.scope: scripts/k8s/**, src-tauri crate, full make verify gate, live colima cluster
